headline: Saginaw Valley State win at Northern Michigan to finish top
dek: The one defeat of Saginaw Valley State's season came at home to Northern Michigan in September; in their final conference match they won the return. They have conceded eleven goals in all, and Northern Michigan, top of the table on Saturday, end behind them.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Northern Michigan alone have scored more than Davenport and St. Cloud State together.

wire.line: Saginaw Valley State finish top, having won away at the only side to beat them this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Luca Rosen has scored sixteen goals from 76 shots for Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Matty Telfer has scored thirteen of Saginaw Valley State's 33 goals, from 55 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Sergio Cano Castro, a freshman, has ten assists for Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mateusz Pass has made 82 saves for Wisconsin-Parkside while conceding seventeen goals.

last_match.line: It ended the hosts' winning run: they had beaten St. Cloud State, Roosevelt and Davenport in turn.

next_match.line: Roosevelt have not won since they beat Davenport at home, and drew at Wisconsin-Parkside last week.
